headline: Three Robberies Hit Singapore Strait
subheadline: Lookout and CCTV at night are key
insight: ReCAAP ISC reports three night boardings in the eastbound lane between 2 and 10 Nov; engine spares stolen and one crew member tied up with a minor injury.

sources.title: ReCAAP warns of further Singapore Strait robberies after three November boardings
One Of The World's Busiest Shipping Lanes Sees Three Robberies In Eight Days
Two incidents of armed robbery against ships in Asia Nov 3-9: ReCAAP

factCheck.notes: Facts cross-checked against at least two independent outlets or the primary statement; only verified facts used.

meta.description: ReCAAP ISC reported three boardings in the eastbound lane of the Singapore Strait TSS at night. On 2 November three perpetrators, one with a gun-like object, boarded the bulk carrier Star Calypso, stole engine spares and tied up a crew member who suffered a minor hand injury. On 4 November seven to eight men were seen on the poop deck of the bulk carrier APJ Priti 2, and on 10 November engine spare parts were stolen from a tanker. ReCAAP urges a sharp lookout at night and CCTV at likely boarding points.
